events.text: Curt Karl Bruno von François was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Curt Karl Bruno von François ( 2 October 1852 – 28 December 1931 )

events.text: Curt von François died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 2 October 1852 – 28 December 1931

events.text: He was responsible for the foundation of the city of Windhoek.
events.subject: self
events.quote: foundation of the city of Windhoek on 18 October 1890

events.text: He was responsible for the foundation of the harbor of Swakopmund.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the harbor of Swakopmund on 4 August 1892

events.text: Curt von François served as a soldier in the Franco-Prussian War.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served as a soldier in the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–71

events.text: Curt von François's service in the Franco-Prussian War ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–71

events.text: His father was killed in action during the Battle of Spicheren.
events.subject: other
events.quote: his father was killed in action during the Battle of Spicheren on 6 August 1870

events.text: He worked as a geographer on an exploratory expedition along the Kasai River.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1883 he worked as a geographer on an exploratory expedition along the Kasai River

events.text: He was stationed as a research officer in German West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1887 he was stationed as a research officer in German West Africa

events.text: Curt von François was engaged by the German Colonial Society to provide security to the territory.
events.subject: self
events.quote: When in 1888 their officials were forcibly expelled from Okahandja , the German Colonial Society engaged Hauptmann Curt von François to provide security to the territory

events.text: He arrived with 21 troopers, 8 soldiers of the Imperial Army and 13 volunteers in Walvis Bay.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June 1889 he arrived with 21 troopers , 8 soldiers of the Imperial Army and 13 volunteers in the British-held enclave of Walvis Bay

events.text: He renewed a former peace agreement with the Herero chief Maharero.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In May 1890 he renewed a former peace agreement with the Herero chief Maharero

events.text: He occupied the completely destroyed settlement of Windhoek.
events.subject: self
events.quote: eventually occupied the completely destroyed settlement of Windhoek

events.text: François set up the new headquarters of the German occupation at Windhoek, which he called Alte Feste.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At Windhoek , François set up the new headquarters of the German occupation ( which he called Alte Feste , Old Fortress )

events.text: François began serving as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.object: Reichskommissar of German South West Africa
events.quote: François served as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa from March 1891 until November 1893

events.text: François's service as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Reichskommissar of German South West Africa
events.quote: François served as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa from March 1891 until November 1893

events.text: He established the coastal town of Swakopmund as the main harbour of German South West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 12 September 1892 ) he established the coastal town of Swakopmund as the main harbour of German South West Africa

events.text: He was promoted to Major and given the title of Landeshauptmann.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In November 1893 he was promoted to Major and given the title of Landeshauptmann

events.text: He led an attack of 225 German soldiers on Nama leader Hendrik Witbooi's headquarters at Hoornkrans.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 April 1893 he led an attack of 225 German soldiers on Nama leader Hendrik Witboois headquarters at Hoornkrans west of Rehoboth

events.text: François's force was formally established as the Imperial Schutztruppe for German South West Africa by the Reich Law.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.object: Imperial Schutztruppe for German South West Africa
events.quote: François force was formally established as the Imperial Schutztruppe for German South West Africa by the Reich Law of 9 June 1895

events.text: François was replaced by Theodor Leutwein as Landeshauptmann of South West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1894 François was replaced by Theodor Leutwein as Landeshauptmann of South West Africa

events.text: François embarked in Cape Town to Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He embarked in Cape Town to Germany

events.text: François retired from military life during the following year.
events.subject: self
events.quote: during the following year he retired from military life

events.text: François died in a Königs Wusterhausen hospital on 28 December 1931.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died in a Königs Wusterhausen hospital on 28 December 1931

events.text: François was buried in the Invalids Cemetery in Berlin.
events.subject: self
events.quote: François was buried in the Invalids Cemetery in Berlin

events.text: A statue of von François was inaugurated in front of Windhoeks municipal buildings.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It was inaugurated on 18 October 1965 on the occasion of the 75th anniversary

events.quote: Reise im Hinterlandes des deutschen Schutzgebiets Togo , Mitteilungen Von Forschungsreisenden Und Gelehrten Aus Den Deutschen Schutzgebieten I , Berlin 1888
